additional_support_fixes: Prepare native DuckDB procedures through SQLCOM_ADMIN_PROC.
master_audit.scope: Port DuckDB functionality and dependencies; retain target trunk implementations for unrelated features.

embedded_duckdb.build: Out-of-source ExternalProject using the selected MySQL compiler; bundle all static extensions with the generated loader, excluding the dummy loader.

independent_changes_excluded: AliSQL vector indexes and vector dictionary upgrades
Generic Binlog Cache Free Flush and Persist Binlog Into Redo
AliSQL release packaging, CI and branding

changes: Move integration to mysql::binlog::event.
Preserve tagged TSIDs, insert-only flags and GTID ownership.
Retain required map locking.
Preserve cascade-trigger status and extend maximum event-status length.
One configured worker selects the existing serial coordinator path for DuckDB multi-transaction batching.
Reject larger effective worker counts at channel startup after replication services initialize.
Preserve native worker-count rules outside DuckDB batching.
Use schema names in storage-engine drop-database callbacks.
Release dictionary objects before their metadata locks.
Release histogram references held by parallel COPY DDL worker tables.
Preserve trunk canonical FIL cache naming during rollback.
Retain trunk optimizer and prepared-statement execution loops.
Gate native query transformations for DuckDB normalization.
Use Date_val, Datetime_val and Time_val APIs.
Convert timestamp-valued TIME results before encoding.
Rewrite zero DATE literals in Boolean normalization.
Report native-procedure parameter errors with correct format arguments.
Use native replication helper paths with matching save/sync semantics and Source/Replica status columns.
Use explicit reconnection and component_keyring_file local manifests.
Reflect native warnings, foreign-key event flags, event lengths and floating AUTO_INCREMENT rejection.
Replace removed MD5 test expressions with length checks while retaining full CHECKSUM TABLE assertions; preserve binary input bytes.

verification.build: GCC12.3.0 / CMake3.26.5 / Ninja Debug; final all-target build passed after clang-format15 formatting.
verification.ctest: All 10 selected targets passed, including the merged small and 2134-case large suites.

unchanged_source_todo_skips.duckdb.create: Pre-existing experimental copy of generic MySQL8.0 create tests (2370 lines), marked PRIMARY KEY TO FIX.
unchanged_source_todo_skips.duckdb.bugfix_crash_after_commit_error: Pre-existing duplicate-key TODO; active duckdb_commit_failed covers commit-failure recovery.

formatting.vendor: Excluded from MySQL formatting; source tree hash verified by CI.

verification.ci_integrity: Formatting workflow excludes only the pinned embedded DuckDB archive and checks its Git tree hash; local YAML, shell and snapshot checks passed.

changes: Share replication table setup and typed DML across seven batch cases, preserving synchronization, binlog rotation and all assertions.
Check ROW format and Debug prerequisites before initializing the replication topology.
Remove the header-level using-directive, use explicit im qualifiers, override/default and nullptr, and correct copied procedure comments.
Run the embedded DuckDB CI snapshot check in the source checkout and trigger it for snapshot, audit and workflow changes.

initialization.synchronization: All initialization-state checks use the manager mutex.
initialization.publication: Publish the owned database only after timezone and UDF initialization succeeds.
initialization.ownership: unique_ptr cleans up an unsuccessful initialization before another connection can retry.

build_isolation.other_platform_default: OFF; explicit ON rejected for unsupported server platforms
build_isolation.clients_only: No embedded DuckDB dependency, even when the option is ON
build_isolation.disabled: No vendor project, backend archive/plugin, backend include directory, native query procedure or DuckDB variables
build_isolation.includes: Backend headers propagate through server target dependencies, not global include directories

metadata_tests.generic_help_and_variable_checks: Independent of optional DuckDB entries; names checked by duckdb.variables_catalog
metadata_tests.engine_dependent_cases: Capability guards and loose startup options allow an OFF build to skip them
